Skill packs shipped with Jarvis Code
====================================

Each folder under this directory is one pack, and each folder inside a pack is
one Agent Skill — SKILL.md plus the resources its instructions name. They are
third-party works, copied verbatim: nothing here has been edited, rebranded or
adapted, because a skill whose body no longer matches its upstream is neither
the skill the author wrote nor one anybody can update.

Every skill keeps the LICENSE file it was published with. Read that file for
the terms; the summary below says where each pack came from and which of its
skills were deliberately left out.


anthropic/  —  https://github.com/anthropics/skills
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vendored at commit 3b3fad96af16a10759d930941b4520ba0c40edae (2026-08-21).

14 skills, each Apache License 2.0, each carrying its own LICENSE.txt:

  academy-guide          brand-guidelines   discernment-nudge   internal-comms
  algorithmic-art        canvas-design      frontend-design     mcp-builder
  skill-creator          slack-gif-creator  theme-factory       web-artifacts-builder
  webapp-testing         claude-api

canvas-design additionally bundles open-source fonts; each face ships beside
its own OFL.txt in canvas-fonts/.

NOT vendored, and why:

  docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx
      Source-available, not open source. Their LICENSE.txt forbids exactly what
      shipping them here would be: "Distribute, sublicense, or transfer these
      materials to any third party", and "retain copies of these materials
      outside the Services". A user who wants them installs them into their own
      profile — Settings > Plugins > add the marketplace anthropics/skills —
      which is the route Anthropic documents for them.

  doc-coauthoring
      The one skill in that repository published with no LICENSE file at all.
      No license is not a permissive one, so there is nothing granting the right
      to redistribute it, and this is the only skill whose omission is a gap
      upstream could close rather than a decision it made.


vercel/  —  https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vendored at commit 435076e78988e1e6ec40d00b0b1d76bdbbc5419a (2026-08-18).

MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Vercel, Inc. The repository is the `skills` CLI
rather than a skill collection, and find-skills is the only skill in it.

The Vercel skill collection people usually mean is a different repository,
vercel-labs/agent-skills (9 skills: composition-patterns, deploy-to-vercel,
react-best-practices, react-native-skills, react-view-transitions,
vercel-cli-with-tokens, vercel-optimize, web-design-guidelines,
writing-guidelines). It ships no LICENSE file and its package is marked
private, so it is not vendored here either; it installs as a marketplace the
same way the Anthropic document skills do.
